scene-u01-pnew3-62.name: text#62
scene-u01-pnew3-62.text: $\alpha$, $\beta$ are products of many small probabilities; in double precision $0.1^{400}$ becomes $0.0$. Forward uses sums, and logs do not pass through sums, so we rescale.

scene-u01-pnew3-66.name: text#66
scene-u01-pnew3-66.text: Splitting into $\alpha\beta$ assumes observations are independent given the state; if they stay correlated within a state, the model is biased.
